# Vendored libraries

Inlined into generated pages at build time, so a page never contacts a CDN. All are MIT-licensed; see each package for its notice.

| File | Package | Version | Use |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cytoscape.min.js` | cytoscape | 3.34.4 | 2D knowledge graph |
| `3d-force-graph.min.js` | 3d-force-graph, bundling three.js | 1.80.2 | Optional 3D view, `--with-3d` |

To update, replace the file from the package's `dist/` and change the version here.
